item.title: Head of Efrat Council: "Someone in London got confused"
item.description:
The head of the Efrat Council, Dovi Shefler, responded to Britain's intention to boycott products from Judea and Samaria.
"The British Mandate ended in May 1948 - someone in London probably got confused and thinks it is still in effect. Our answer should be to return all of Prikot Shlom to Israeli control," said Scheffler.

item.title: UK: Hamas cannot play a role in the future government in Gaza and must disarm
item.description: British Foreign Secretary Miliband said that Israel has the right to live without fear of threats from a terrorist regime, but that this does not justify what happened in Gaza. He added that some 70,000 people have been killed in the Strip, including, according to him, 20,000 children.

item.title: Watch: Three illegal residents caught hiding at Golan guesthouse
item.description: Police arrested three Hebron residents allegedly staying illegally at a Golan Heights guesthouse. One was found hiding injured inside a sewage channel.

item.title: Herzog to foreign governments: Step back from the dead end of sanctions and boycotts
item.description:
President Isaac Herzog addressed discussions in Britain and other countries about imposing sanctions, saying that if they are enacted, “it would constitute a grave error in judgment and a choice to stand on the wrong side of history."
Herzog added that such measures would amount to “blatant interference in democratic elections" and urged foreign governments: “Stop! Step back from the dead end of sanctions and boycotts."

item.description: Kiryat Malachi’s flag is raised at a new twin cities square near Paris, with an Israeli diplomat hailing the gesture as one of ‘friendship and solidarity.’
